en: Multiview postcard with a bright blue frame featuring historic sights of Alba Iulia, Romania (titles use the city's historical names: Apulon, Apulum, Bălgrad, Alba-Iulia). Small numbered images show: the Alba Iulia fortress area, the tower of the Roman Catholic St. Michael's Cathedral, the Coronation (Reunification) Cathedral, the equestrian statue of Michael the Brave, the Obelisk of Horea, Cloșca și Crișan, and several commemorative plaques. A Romanian blurb at the bottom calls Alba Iulia a bi‑millenary city. The reverse side has address lines and the publisher credit of the Orthodox Archdiocese, and an inner text panel with long descriptions in Romanian, English, French, and German explaining each numbered view.
